claims.claim: Simcoe County staff say alternative Oro leachate disposal could add more than $450,000 in annual hauling and treatment costs.
claims.episode_span: more than $450,000 a year in hauling and treatment
claims.source_title: County seeks extension from Collingwood to accept Oro Landfill leachate
claims.supporting_quote: Simcoe County is seeking a one-year extension from the Town of Collingwood to continue accepting leachate from the Oro Landfill, warning that alternative disposal arrangements could add more than $450,000 in annual transportation and treatment costs while longer-term solutions are developed.

claims.claim: Collingwood council voted unanimously in July to give two months' notice that it would no longer accept Oro-Medonte landfill leachate.
claims.episode_span: Collingwood council voted unanimously in July to give two months' notice
claims.source_title: County seeks extension from Collingwood to accept Oro Landfill leachate
claims.supporting_quote: Collingwood council voted unanimously back in July to give two months' notice to the county that it will no longer accept leachate from Oro-Medonte’s landfill to run through Collingwood’s wastewater treatment plant.

claims.claim: An agreement allowed the county to process up to 13 litres per second of leachate into the Collingwood force-main.
claims.episode_span: an agreement allowing up to 13 litres per second into the force-main
claims.source_title: County seeks extension from Collingwood to accept Oro Landfill leachate
claims.supporting_quote: “Last year, we were provided notice that they were no longer able to treat that, so we were trucking that over to the Collingwood landfill site, for which there was an agreement allowing us to process up to 13 litres per second of leachate into the force-main system,” Elliott said.

claims.claim: David Zamida's second-degree murder trial is scheduled to begin Feb. 14, 2028.
claims.source_title: Wasaga man's murder trial delayed until February 2028
claims.supporting_quote: It's scheduled to begin on Feb. 14, 2028 — about four years after McKinven was found critically injured near the accused’s Homewood Avenue home in Wasaga Beach on Feb. 25, 2024.

claims.claim: Zamida, 49, is charged with second-degree murder and remains in custody.
claims.episode_span: He is charged with second-degree murder in the 2024 death of Peter McKinven and remains in custody.
claims.source_title: Wasaga man's murder trial delayed until February 2028
claims.supporting_quote: Zamida, 49, who is referred to as Michael Zamida in some court documents, is charged with second-degree murder. The Wasaga Beach man remains in custody.

claims.claim: The Wasaga Beach Costco gas bar has 18 pumps and 800 parking spots.
claims.episode_span: the station has 18 pumps and 800 parking spots
claims.source_title: The lines were long in Wasaga Beach at the new Costco Gas Bar pumps
claims.supporting_quote: Constructed this year, it boasts an 18-pump gas station – and 800 parking spots.

claims.claim: Southern Georgian Bay OPP issued one driver a Highway Traffic Act summons and charged another under the Cannabis Control Act during a RIDE check.
claims.episode_span: issued one driver a Highway Traffic Act summons and charged another under the Cannabis Control Act
claims.supporting_quote: Southern Georgian Bay OPP officers issue one driver a Highway Traffic Act summons and charge another under the Cannabis Control Act

claims.claim: Grey County's three long-term care homes filed 18 critical incident reports between August 15 and October 14, and improper-care reports rose from four to 15 in a year.
claims.episode_span: filed 18 critical incident reports with the province between August 15 and October 14
claims.source_title: Abuse and Neglect Reports Rose at Grey County Long-Term Care Homes Over the Past Year
claims.supporting_quote: Reports of improper care rose from four to 15 in a year at Grey County’s three long-term care homes, the county’s own committee reports show.

claims.claim: Five of the reports fall under abuse and neglect, and inspectors issued seven written notices in September.
claims.episode_span: Five of the 18 reports sit in abuse and neglect.
claims.source_title: Abuse and Neglect Reports Rose at Grey County Long-Term Care Homes Over the Past Year
claims.supporting_quote: Five of the reports fall under abuse and neglect, a category that covers “any alleged, suspected, or witnessed” abuse of a resident by anyone, or neglect by the home or its staff.

claims.claim: Grey County beaver compensation doubles from $25 to $50 on January 1, 2027, and trappers must get county authorization before starting work.
claims.episode_span: Payments double on January 1, 2027, from $25 to $50 per beaver
claims.source_title: Grey County trappers raise concerns over beaver compensation changes
claims.supporting_quote: Grey County's revised program will double compensation from $25 to $50 per beaver beginning January 1, 2027.
